name: nonApi_setTrackNotes
description: Fills a hasher's notes on a run from an imported file's title, description, private note and stats line: when the notes are blank, or when the existing notes are exactly the start of the new text (an earlier import's fill, extended by a re-import — 1.1.0, 2026-09-12). Text the hasher wrote or edited is never touched. Called by the track-import processor for every activity that matched a run.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The hasher who imported the file.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Title, blank line, description, private note and stats line; trimmed. NULL or blank (LEN 0 — emoji-safe) ⇒ no-op, but the parameter has no default so it must still be passed.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET Notes WHERE EventId/UserId match, removed = 0, and Notes is NULL / blank / a case-sensitive prefix of the new text — the HEM trigger restamps updatedAt (the row re-syncs).
On any runtime error: rolls back if a transaction is open, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<unknown>', userId, eventId), then THROWs.

codeSmells.detail: @eventId, @userId, @notes have no SQL default. Called only by the API's track-import processor (ProcessTrackImport), which always passes all three. A call that omits one fails before the body runs — no HC.ErrorLog row, no graceful check (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default').

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
